assessment_objectives.objective: the frequency at which event logs and security-relevant telemetry are transferred to a different system, system component or media other than the system or system component conducting the logging is defined.

event logs and security-relevant telemetry are transferred per an organization-defined frequency to a different system, system component or media other than the system or system component conducting the logging.

event logs and security-relevant telemetry are stored per an organization-defined frequency in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.
